summary.text: Liver Life is Fang Yuan's Immortal Gu House in Star Collection City. Twelfth Hair presents it to mermaid immortals after its conversion from a formation.

claims.text: Solid Rock Warrior developed an incomplete transformation path Immortal Gu recipe for hard liver Gu, which strengthens a Gu Immortal’s liver for lasting energy but can harden the liver to the limit and trigger a terrifying explosion if used excessively. Fang Yuan completed the recipes through rank eight, refined rank eight hard liver Immortal Gu as the core of a Gu formation, named that formation the liver life formation, and ran it year round for a contribution-point fee so users would leave full of energy and motivation.
Deviation (recorded): this page is filed under gu-houses because Liver Life is a named Immortal Gu House. It is equipment inside the sovereign immortal aperture, not a five-region map seat.

Guiding a group of mermaid immortals through Star Collection City, Twelfth Hair stops at the hall and tells them it was once a formation called the liver life formation before Fang Yuan modified it into an Immortal Gu House. He praises it as having an excellent, useful effect, and the account leaves the mermaid immortals with a deep impression.

Lian Ke Xin sends the exhausted Yu Zi to Liver Life Hall and has just left it herself. Yu Zi recalls that Liver Life Hall was only a liver life formation before, and that master modified it into an Immortal Gu House so it would not be disturbed the way immortal formations are when abnormal situations strike the sovereign immortal aperture. She enters with familiarity; the hall shakes as nearby Gu Immortals joke that someone’s liver exploded again. After her liver explodes, Fang Yuan’s will offers many treatment plans, including the immortal killer move salt water liver, which can create a new liver with water path and food path dao marks and can bear the support of Liver Life Hall much longer across many more uses. Yu Zi chooses salt water liver for its performance-cost ratio.
